name: Anamizu (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Anamizu town emblem in white: two outlined loops with a stylised letter M between them.
history: Municipal flag of Anamizu, a town in Ishikawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 January 1959.

features.role: Anamizu town emblem — two outlined loops with a stylised letter M between them
